staged_raw_reports.scope: Exact candidate8 shipping SFX: nine production-backend checks and nine selected media checks; the initial zero-count Light representative check is excluded.
selected_check_names: Single release EXE extracts runtime and opens its own visible Flutter window with no browser/WebView children
All four approved pages load in the production Flutter/Go app
Exact two developer names and emails are shown at the top of sources and diagnostics
Simple three-choice quality dropdown can change and persist the Windows-only preference
Production in-app clear confirmation can cancel without changing persistent records
Actual read-only library write failure retains rows and allows retry
Actual production backend clears disk history while preserving favorites, bindings and settings
Repeated single-file launch restores the existing native window
Full release EXE restart keeps history empty and favorite available; window close ends child family
A viewport smaller than the source leaves the original 720p texture and avoids shader work
Actual shipping libmpv renders EASU and RCAS into a 1920x1080 output texture from a 1280x720 source
Enhanced 720p30 playback continues through at least ten measured shader and frame-drop samples on the local RTX 4060
Off removes FSR shader passes and restores the 1280x720 native output texture
Leaving playback pauses the active synthetic video, restore stays paused and manual resume continues it
Stop followed by replay advances video without losing the playback surface
Switching episodes keeps native video decoding and time progress
Continuous synthetic 720p HLS decodes through the authenticated relay and advances time
Actual Windows minimize pauses the native player and restore remains paused
